job.title: [Post] Hiring Sap Hybris technical consultant. shubha jv 10y. Immediate opening on Abinitio with…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Technical Consultant | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and data integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer experienced in technical consulting, requirements engineering, and collaborating with international teams in agile environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Hybris technical consultant
cover_en.hook: As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with over 5 years of hands-on expertise building and optimizing enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for your SAP Hybris technical consultant position. I bring deep technical proficiency in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and complex system integrations.

bullets.label: SAP Hybris & Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) using Java and Spring, following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API Integration & Data Flows
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and designed PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize global catalogs.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Acted as a techno-functional consultant bridging business and IT, translating complex requirements into robust enterprise e-commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performed database query optimizations, and supported large-scale production environments.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP Hybris expertise can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud experience to shubha jv, helping your team deliver robust technical consulting, seamless system integrations, and high-performance e-commerce architectures for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, robust technical integration skills, and strong techno-functional consulting experience to deliver high-impact e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, specializing in Java, Spring, and complex integrations. I am very interested in your SAP Hybris technical consultant opening. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Hybris technical consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Hybris technical consultant position. With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs, and system integrations.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your project needs.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
